summary: Iter126 CheerPlanner 2.0 share-link + assign_role fix verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (test_iter126_share_link_fixes.py against public preview URL). (1) POST /api/team/roster/{id}/request-info for a COACH resolves — GET /api/public/share/{token}/data returns 200 with member.role='coach'. (2) Same call for an ATHLETE still returns 200 (no regression). (3) Stale-link refresh: after backdating share_links.created_at to 45 days ago, a second request-info call MINTS A NEW token; the OLD token is 404 and the NEW token is 200 on /public/share/{token}/data. (4) Public HTML /api/public/s/{token}: an unknown token shows exactly 'This link is invalid or has been turned off.'; a genuinely EXPIRED (created_at 60 days ago, active=true) token shows 'This link has expired. Please ask for a new one.' and DOES NOT show the invalid message. (5) assign_role auto-match: pre-seeded unlinked coach roster row with email X + a new user signing up with email X + POST /api/team/members/{uid}/assign-role {role:'coach'} with NO athlete_roster_id -> 200, response.athlete_roster_id == the pre-existing row, row.linked_id == juid, exactly ONE roster row for that email remains. (6) Non-destructive consolidation: with a survivor roster row + a duplicate (linked_id=user) with an ACTIVE roster_member share_link on the duplicate, POST assign-role {role:'athlete', athlete_roster_id: survivorId} -> duplicate deleted, share_links.ref_id re-pointed to survivor, active=true preserved, AND /public/share/{token}/data still returns 200 pointing at survivorId. (7) Auth: /assign-role rejects no-token (401), and a joiner using their own token cannot flip their own pending status in the owner's hub (state preserved). No frontend testing (backend-only per request).
critical_code_review_comments: share.py::_get_link raises HTTP 404 for both invalid AND expired links (only the `detail` differs). Callers that check status_code cannot differentiate; the public HTML page correctly reads the detail text, but any programmatic API consumer would need to inspect the JSON body to tell them apart. Consider using distinct 404/410 codes to make the difference machine-readable.

team_members.py::_match_existing_roster does a case-insensitive regex match on `email` using $regex — for a truly large roster this could bypass indexes. Not a correctness issue at demo scale, but worth an index or normalized `email_lower` field long-term.

share.py::request_member_info doesn't return whether the link was newly minted or reused; callers can't tell that a refresh happened. A `refreshed: true/false` flag would help the frontend show 'we sent a fresh link' UX after a stale-link refresh.

team_members.py::_consolidate_roster fetches up to 100 duplicates but the pymongo call `.to_list(100)` is a hard cap without a warning — in the pathological case of >100 auto-created duplicates, some would leak. Consider paginating or logging when the cap is hit.

share.py::public_page catches HTTPException and always responds with status_code=404 even for genuinely valid but unsupported link kinds — acceptable, but the detail 'Unsupported link' from public_data would surface via the /data fetch not the /s HTML. Not a bug, just noting the two paths render errors differently.
seed_data_creation: All test data is prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up in fixtures. demo_ctx fixture deletes any share_link tokens minted during the run against the demo account (identified by token). owner_ctx fixture spins up a fresh TEST_own126_{tag} owner, seeds roster/team_members via signup + direct DB inserts for role rows, and on teardown deletes: db.roster (by user_id), db.team_members (by household_id), db.athlete_chat_links (by household_id), db.share_links (by user_id), and db.users (regex ^TEST_). No demo roster rows were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login for the demo owner: POST /api/auth/login {email:'demo@cheerplanner.app', password:'CheerDemo2026!'} -> access_token+user.id. Roster listing is GET /api/roster (returns a list; group by .role to find athlete/coach/staff/team_rep). Public share link fetch: GET /api/public/share/{token}/data (JSON) and GET /api/public/s/{token} (HTML). Backdating a share link for expiry tests: db.share_links.update_one({token}, {'$set':{'created_at': ISO of now-45d, 'active': True}}). TTL is 30 days (SHARE_LINK_TTL_DAYS in share.py). To set up assign_role scenarios: signup a new user with the matching email, join with POST /api/team/join {code} using the team_join_code from GET /api/team/join-code, then POST /api/team/members/{user_id}/assign-role {role}. Pytest runs from /app with env sourced from /app/backend/.env (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME) and EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env is auto-picked up from process env if present, else falls back to localhost:8001.
